description: Texts with DECtalk's spelling mode turned on or off by a mode command inside the text: between sentences, inside a sentence, on and off again, off after a text that began in the mode, taken away by another mode's set, before a sentence that begins with an auxiliary or a question word, after a comma, and together with a voice and a rate command. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.

entries.text: The tide went out. [:mode spell on] We sat down.
The boat [:mode spell on] came in.
The tide went out. [:mode spell set] We sat down.
The tide went out, [:mode spell on] and we sat down.
[:mode spell on] The tide. [:mode spell off] We sat down.
The tide [:mode spell on] went [:mode spell off] out again.
[:mode spell on] The tide [:mode name set] went out.
The tide went out. [:mode spell on] We sat. [:mode spell off] The rain began. [:mode spell on] Go.
The tide went out. [:mode spell on] Is it out? [:mode spell off] Is it in?
The tide went out. [:mode spell on] What is it? [:mode spell off] What is it?
The tide went out. [:nb][:mode spell on] We sat down. [:np][:mode spell off] The rain began.
The tide went out. [:mode spell on][:rate 240] We sat. [:rate 180][:mode spell off] The rain began.
